clade_ii_era.description: Nigeria Clade II (suspected cases, 2017–2023) — within-era performance

clade_i_shift.description: Nigeria Clade I (confirmed cases, 2024) — cross-clade performance

distribution_shift.interpretation: The -0.022-point AUC drop and 0.157-point sensitivity drop between Clade II test and Clade I test quantify the cost of the cross-clade distribution shift. This finding motivates adaptive/online learning approaches for variant-agnostic outbreak surveillance.
